newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee low on foreign strength of dollar.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee low on foreign strength of dollar.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee, which remained untraded early on Wednesday, fell in line with overseas strength of the dollar after the Central Bank announced its trading range, dealers said.
At 0500 GMT the rupee was at 57.12 to the dollar after closing at 57.09 on Tuesday.
"There were no trades until the Central Bank announced its range in line with foreign gains by the dollar. Then speculative buying pushed it up," said a Standard Chartered dealer.
The Central Bank took the dollar up by 3.75 local cents, and set buying and selling prices at 56.4300 and 57.5700.
Call money rates fell to 12.25 percent after opening at 13.5 and rising to 14.75 when the Central Bank cut its overnight repo rate to 11.75 percent from 12.0, dealers said.
